title: Versant to Report Third Quarter 2026 Operating and Financial Results
summary: NEW YORK --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 6, 2026-- Versant Media Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: VSNT) today announced it will report third quarter 2026 operating and financial results on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, and will hold a conference call on the same day at 8:00 a.m. ET.
body_markdown:
NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 6, 2026-- Versant Media Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: VSNT) today announced it will report third quarter 2026 operating and financial results on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, and will hold a conference call on the same day at 8:00 a.m. ET. The call will be hosted by Versant’s Chief Executive Officer, Mark Lazarus, and Chief Financial Officer and Chief Operating Officer, Anand Kini.


A live audio webcast of the call will be available on Versant’s Investor Relations website at[investors.versantmedia.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.versantmedia.com&esheet=54617177&newsitemid=20261006440713&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.versantmedia.com&index=1&md5=570397afb94e6cbe82a18c5b126432e2) . A replay of the audio webcast will also be available on Versant’s Investor Relations website following the conference call.


To participate by telephone, dial (877) 407-0832 (toll-free) or +1 (201) 689-8433 (local). Please dial in at least 10 minutes prior to the start of the call and request to be connected to the Versant earnings conference call.


To receive Versant’s latest press releases, financial updates, and event notifications, please visit our Investor Relations website at[investors.versantmedia.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.versantmedia.com&esheet=54617177&newsitemid=20261006440713&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.versantmedia.com&index=2&md5=3d963649af15f88587b94ed578fb2845) and subscribe to email alerts.


**About Versant**


Versant Media Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, USA Sports, Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow, GolfPass and Full Swing. Visit[www.VersantMedia.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.VersantMedia.com&esheet=54617177&newsitemid=20261006440713&lan=en-US&anchor=www.VersantMedia.com&index=3&md5=3a325f871b25044fcf3023f34a11a4da) for more information.
